_comment: Stormwood named NPC registry draft. Positions follow authored landmarks/routes. Body profiles reuse installed humanoid inventory; runtime spawn integration is intentionally unbound in this lane.

distinct_bodies_1111._why_on: ON (GPU High, LANE-SCOUT G-places-stormlight, tb/item-scout-1108 6ece0b6f, 12 Nov 2026; three code-blind judges): with storm_phase_1111, F41#8 named silhouettes 5.22 -> 5.80 (+0.58, 3/3); alone it scored +0.29 (G-meshy-f41-8-distinct-bodies).
distinct_bodies_1111._candidate: F41#8 (LANE-MESHY, 11 Nov 2026; OFF until judged; row 5.31 after five attempts). Elder Maud, Rodkeeper Hesk and Warden-elect Bryn share the local_historian body (an elderly cloaked figure with a cane), so the trio read as one person three times. ON gives Hesk the installed alpha_tracker body (brimmed hat, field gear: the outdoor keeper of the storm rods) and Bryn the installed lost_traveler body (a younger, lighter figure: the newly chosen warden). Maud keeps local_historian and her appearance variant (the elder). Neither body is used elsewhere in Stormwood. Both are from the installed T1 NPC cast (owner's Meadows NPC Design Board), so no new mesh. Role accessories (rod staff, oilskin hat) stay. Names, dialogue and positions are unchanged.
distinct_bodies_1111._why_variants: Judge c (G-meshy-f41-8-distinct-bodies, +0.29 2/3): at small size Hesk and Bryn share a tan-and-brown palette; Bryn wears teal-green (hue 165) cloth, so the trio reads tan (Hesk), blue-grey (Maud, lanekit variant) and teal (Bryn).

Moved onto solid deck at local (+10, -20) (east of the ring gap where the ascent rises through, segments 43-47), 10 m from the ascent landing, off every discharge lane and plate (stormwood_dynamo.json).
